title: Three gravity emitters on the sports model craft

tellings.quote: Years before Ning Li's work ever became public, Lazar described [music] three cylindrical emitters at the base of a craft.

plain: Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien craft at a secret Nevada site called S4 in 1988 and 1989, described three cylindrical emitters at the base of a craft he calls the sports model, which he says made gravity to move it. Michels tells this himself and points out that Lazar said it years before the physicist Ning Li's work on gravity became public, which to him suggests Lazar knew something real early.
